name: 涂鸦面板容器
description: 手绘涂鸦风格的面板容器（入驻 panel-container 区域）：顶部为涂鸦标签条（自动收纳全部 panel 区域插件），下方展台为每个面板插件各驻留一个独立 iframe（切换仅显隐、不重载），并负责把子插件与宿主之间的消息双向中继。
description-en: Hand-drawn doodle panel container that lives in the panel-container area: a doodle tab strip hosts every panel-area plugin, each rendered in its own persistent iframe (show/hide only, never reloaded), and relays messages between child plugins and the host.
